scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @proofline/api" "npm run dev -w @proofline/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @proofline/core && npm run build -w @proofline/web && npm run build -w @proofline/api && npm run build -w @proofline/mcp
scripts.test: npm run test -w @proofline/core && npm run test -w @proofline/api && npm run test -w @proofline/mcp && npm run test:contract && npm run test:workflow && npm run test:web && npm run test:fullstack
scripts.test:web: npm run test:unit -w @proofline/web && npm run test:e2e -w @proofline/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @proofline/core && npm run typecheck -w @proofline/api && npm run typecheck -w @proofline/web && npm run typecheck -w @proofline/mcp && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.check: npm run build -w @proofline/core && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run compile:contract
